source_name: Social Security Administration, Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) information
text:
Social Security Administration
Important information
Date: September 26, 2026

Your new benefit amount
Beginning January 2027, your Social Security benefit will increase by 2.8 percent because of a rise in the cost of living.

Your monthly amount (before deductions) is $1,947.30
The amount we deduct for Medicare medical insurance is $202.90
The amount we will pay you on January 21, 2027 is $1,744.40

If you disagree with this decision, you have 60 days to ask for an appeal.
You can see this notice in your my Social Security account at www.ssa.gov/myaccount.
If you have questions, call us at 1-800-772-1213. We will never ask you to pay to receive your benefit increase.
